verdict_scope: Static review of r3 delta, registration pin check against disk, CPU-only focused tests. Parent-owned gates remain: exact lease install, unmocked full preflight, single launch, full validate_outputs on real output.
evidence_scope: Not run: preflight, worker, launcher, MPS, environment, games, training, checkpoint decode, lease install, doc writes.

findings.summary: expected_checkpoint_counters uses bare next(); out-of-range update raises StopIteration instead of a named error.
findings.failure_scenario: Production only calls with EVALUATION_UPDATES, so no launch impact; a future caller passing 277 gets StopIteration. test_entry_counter_binding.py accepts StopIteration.
findings.fix: Use next((...), None) and r.need(row is not None, ...); tighten test to expect ValueError.

findings.summary: No full synthetic fixture for validate_outputs; counter lookup and saved-LR assertion only covered by focused helper tests.
findings.failure_scenario: A validate_outputs-internal mismatch surfaces only after a real campaign terminal output.
findings.fix: Parent decides: build synthetic fixture before launch, or accept gap and run full gate on real output.

findings.summary: runner module is imported (and runner.py runs as worker script) before any pin verification; launcher/runner bytes rely on frozen dir and parent preflight.
findings.failure_scenario: Swapped runner.py before launch bypasses in-process pin checks. Same posture as accepted launcher entrypoint; helper is now post-verify.
findings.fix: None required for this review; parent preflight covers.

findings.summary: Entry gate requires 64 MPS phase-204 rows equal to predecessor rows exactly; only an MPS run confirms reproducibility.
findings.failure_scenario: If evaluation is not bit-reproducible on MPS, the single-use lease is consumed by entry evaluation only (fail-fast, not full training).
findings.fix: Parent confirms predecessor was produced by the same evaluate path on MPS before lease install.
